title: Buducnost rally past SC Derby to lift Erste Liga trophy
description: SC Derby - Buducnost 83-90 Buducnost earned the 16th Erste Liga title. They overcame SC Derby in Game 4 of the Finals to capture the trophy. The guests trailed by 1 point after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 9-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 90-83. Buducnost made 19-of-24 free shots (79.2 percent) during the game. 28 personal fouls committed by SC Derby helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American point guard Yogi Ferrell (183-1993, college: Indiana) fired 23 points and 7 assists for the winners. Bosnian center Kenan Kamenjas (207-2000) chipped in 15 points and 9 rebounds. The former international Emir Hadzibegovic (204-1996) produced 16 points and 5 rebounds (on 6-of-7 shooting from the field) and the former international point guard Igor Drobnjak (188-2000) added 16 points respectively for lost side.
